# Fixtures

All files here are **synthetic**, generated by `scripts/generar-fixtures.py`. No real
data: the institution is "Example Bank", the holders are the German specimen names
(Erika and Max Mustermann), tax numbers are placeholders, and the IBAN and ISIN are the
public examples of their standards, chosen because their check digits are valid.

- `valid-2.0.xml`, `valid-3.0.xml`: an exchange ES → DE that passes the XSD and every
  rule.
- `valid-domestic-3.0.xml`: the same report filed domestically (ES → ES) with national
  identifiers.
- `<code>-<what>.xml`: the valid file with one change that breaks one rule.
- `expected.json`: the exact set of rules each file must trigger. `tests/test_fixtures.py`
  checks it, and checks that these files are what the script generates.

`50009-same-messagerefid.xml` triggers nothing on its own: it repeats the
`MessageRefId` of `valid-3.0.xml`, so it fails only when both are linted in one run.

Regenerate with `python scripts/generar-fixtures.py`.
